description: This file defines the WorkoutRepository class, which provides methods to fetch workout lists and workout details from a remote API, acting as a data repository layer in the application.

classes.name: WorkoutRepository
classes.description: Repository for workout list and details, encapsulating API calls for fetching workout data.

methods.name: fetchWorkouts
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches a list of workouts filtered by optional criteria such as category, level, and duration range.

methods.name: fetchWorkoutDetail
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches detailed information of a specific workout by its ID.
